profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Distributed Databases | Apache Cassandra Committer/PMC
profile.summary: Senior Staff Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience, primarily building and operating distributed databases at scale. Apache Cassandra committer/PMC since 2013. Ran a 100K+ instance Cassandra fleet at Apple, introduced CockroachDB at Netflix, and was tech lead for teams running one of the largest MongoDB deployments at Stripe. Previously led development of Readyset’s SQL caching engine.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led engineering team building a SQL caching engine for Postgres and MySQL.

* Tech lead for a team of 8 engineers developing Readyset’s core SQL caching engine, setting technical roadmap with the CEO and VP Product. Worked across the full stack: wire protocol, query parsing and planning, dataflow execution, storage, upstream replication, and cache invalidation.
* Eliminated multi-hour customer cache outages by implementing online index builds; previously, creating a cache could take existing caches offline for hours.
* Led a wire-protocol performance effort on the MySQL and Postgres proxies: over 2x throughput and more
than 50% lower p95 latency on large result sets, and 20–25% more throughput and up to 50% lower tail
latency (p999) via syscall and TLS-record coalescing.
* Removed the legacy sharding and replication subsystems, which couldn't be reliably operated in production, cutting maintenance burden and simplifying the product.
* Worked directly with customers on evaluations and production deployments; built features they needed, including spatial data types, correlated subquery support, and replication observability.
positions.insights: Skills: MySQL · PostgreSQL · Rust (Programming Language) · Cache Management · Distributed Databases

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Committer and PMC on the Apache Cassandra project.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Online Databases org, DocumentDB team: operated MongoDB for Stripe's OLTP workloads.

* Tech lead for 2 teams and technical advisor to 3 more within the DocumentDB organization, which operated one of the world’s largest MongoDB deployments (~25,000 nodes, ~2,000 replsets); set requirements, vetted feature sets, and shaped team roadmaps.
* Mentored all DocumentDB engineers via a series of presentations on MongoDB internals and database fundamentals, plus 1:1 career growth sessions.
* Drove the data durability program with product, performance, and engineering leadership, reducing data loss incidents by over 90%.
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · PostgreSQL · Databases · Distributed Databases · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Introduced CockroachDB for multi-region transactional workloads

* Tech lead for Netflix distributed SQL initiative: evaluated 10 distributed SQL databases against high-availability requirements and secured engineering-wide alignment on CockroachDB through a series of townhalls.
* Drove adoption across database, infrastructure, security, and product teams; designed, deployed, and operated 20+ multi-region (US, EU) clusters for high-availability transactional workloads.
* Led cross-team efforts to make CockroachDB production-ready: Java client drivers wrapping pgjdbc, X.509 certificate authentication with security, and CDC into Data Mesh for analytics.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · CockroachDB · Distributed Systems · Distributed Databases · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Cassandra Storage team - Ran Cassandra at iCloud scale and contributed upstream.

* Operated one of the world’s largest Cassandra fleets (100K+ instances) powering iCloud services.
* Rewrote peer-to-peer networking layer, which improved node recovery time by 20% and node launch from minutes to less than 3 seconds.
* Prototyped pluggable storage engine for Cassandra on non-volatile memory (CASSANDRA-13981). Shelved when Intel discontinued Optane.
* Contributed major features and bug fixes back to Apache Cassandra, working closely with the Legal team to expand OSS contributions at Apple.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Applied Machine Learning team

* Co-authored new secondary index implementation (SASI) which improved retrieval times by 80% on secondary index queries.
* Implemented file-level encryption in Cassandra for internal deployments.
* Developed a proof-of-concept distributed graph database on top of Cassandra.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I led a small team that was the first adopter of Cassandra at Netflix as well as running the AB testing infrastructure. Migrated several services out of Netflix's datacenter and into our EC2 deployment. Worked on Cassandra and related tooling. Delivered several internal talks on topics such as Cassandra as well as HTTP caching/Squid.

positions.description: Rebuilt mlb.com subscription platform into scalable SOA, growing digital content profit 20% YoY
